elements_selected.content: Write integration tests for TEST-050 (VCS Independence, NFR-017). Tests must explicitly verify that all commands work identically whether or not a .git directory is present. Three scenarios: 1) Vault in a plain directory (no .git) — run zetl index, zetl check, zetl blocks, zetl reason status; assert all succeed and git fields are absent or null, 2) Git metadata is optional enrichment — create a vault inside a tempfile git repo (git init), run zetl reason provenance, verify git_commit and git_dirty fields are present; then remove .git and re-run, verify identical output except git fields are null, 3) Cache validity is VCS-independent — index inside a git repo, then remove .git, run zetl index, verify cache is still valid (no re-indexing) and git fields become null. Use tempfile and std::process::Command to run zetl binary. Note: these tests do NOT require an actual git installation — use conditional compilation or skip gracefully when git is not available.
